topic: The king so feared his name was erased from every record in history
hook: A king so feared, his own people erased him from history.
script: A king so feared, his own people erased him from history. Pharaoh Akhenaten abandoned Egypt's gods, created a new religion, and moved the capital. After his death, priests erased his name from every monument. Every statue. Every record. For 3000 years he didn't exist. Then archaeologists found him by accident in 1887. History buried alive. Follow for pharaohs history tried to forget.
